facts.fact_value: {"name":"Welding Classes","desc":"Ready to channel your inner blacksmith? Thrill seekers and fans of Forged in Fire will love taking a blacksmithing class at our workshop in Brooklyn! The ancient art of blacksmithing is one of the oldest trades in human history, dating back over 3,000 years. {"name":"Russian Axe","desc":"This axe head was located by the donors on the beach, just west of the docks here in Taft. It was essentially just a ball of rust when found. The donors took it home and stripped it of its rust, revealing this historic, hand-forged, Russian axe head. The donors then turned to social media to try to understand the unique makers-mark on the axe head. After many back-and-forth conversations with their archaeological friends, it was determined that the writing for the maker’s-mark was written in Russian. This creates many more questions behind the story of this axe head. Was it a trade-good that was used by a north Lincoln County pioneer, or possibly from a Russian shipwreck? We may never know"}

{"name":"Greek pottery","desc":"Wheel-made pottery was long established by the Bronze Age (ca. 3000-1100 BCE), and utilitarian vessels, decorated or not, were essential to the cultures of the ancient Mediterranean.
